subject: notification policy
scenario: A chat space that receives every keystroke stops being read, and an incidents space that receives routine traffic loses its authority at 03:00. Worker-level activity is recorded, never pushed.
expected_behaviors: Every routed channel exists, and no webhook URL is stored in the repository.
Every event type in the catalogue has a routing outcome.
failure_conditions: A worker-level event is routed to a channel.
An event type has no routing outcome.
